parsed.why: Same-sex conduct criminalised with documented state raids; no LGBTI registration or redress; political endorsement of stoning; armed-group killings and torture; underground life erased. Outing risks arrest plus severe non-state violence.

Decriminalised 2022 and Pride/TDOR vigils held, but cleaver attack yielded only a fine (impunity), employment law excludes gender identity, and fundamentalist and official hostility persists. No documented visitor-facing restriction.

Decriminalised, no trans-specific offence or border/facility rule; equality body, broadcaster regulator and courts demonstrably act. Offsets are rising official anti-gender rhetoric, one city's attempted Pride ban with fines, and protections not naming gender identity.

No criminalisation, but acceptance scores 5/100, 2024 report documents torture, sexual violence and extortion; police 12-hour response, MPs called for a trans woman to be burned alive, no protection statute — hostile society with thin recourse.

Cross-dressing offence directly targets presentation; sodomy carries up to life; documented state extrajudicial killings and torture of LGBTQIA+ people, official reliance on fatwas blocking transition, conflict and no recognition or recourse.
